headline: TRITN jumps 50.00% intraday as it files to establish a new subsidiary.
market_take: Construction stocks showed mixed volatility with TRITN soaring 50.00% and TPOLY sliding 10.00% on a price gap. Property sector rallied, led by STELLA (+15.38%) and PRECHA (+13.89%). PF&REITs were active, highlighted by AIMCG's 14.47% rise on strong volume. Food stocks generated multiple volume spikes but limited price moves, while agribusiness saw modest gains across TL and VPO.

sector_notes.note: TRITN surged 50.00% intraday; TPOLY opened down 10.00% and SQ gapped -5.26%. BJCHI reported share repurchase filings and TRC disclosed negative equity clarification.
STELLA rose 15.38% and PRECHA 13.89% on solid volume. AKS received an SP trading sign indicating possible delisting, and LPN completed a share repurchase program.
AIMCG posted a 14.47% intraday gain with a 7.4σ volume spike. TTLPF and CPNCG disclosed capital reductions, underscoring ongoing restructuring.
CHOTI, TC, PB and TWPC each logged volume spikes above 6σ. MADAME announced a new joint venture, while TU filed CFO changes and CPF reported a capital reduction.
TL and VPO climbed around 4.6% each. TEGH and SMO recorded notable volume spikes, indicating heightened trading interest.
PPP added 5.26% on modest volume; DCON opened with a -5.26% price gap, flagged as an unusual‑trading alert.
